lines.en: Three a.m., the server's down, the pager's screaming red
lines.zh: 凌晨三点，服务器宕机，告警刺眼地红着

lines.en: You read ten thousand lines of logs while I just held my head
lines.zh: 你读完上万行日志，而我只能抱着头

lines.en: You found the race condition hiding in the cache
lines.zh: 你找出了藏在缓存里的竞态条件

lines.en: Rolled back the bad migration right before the crash
lines.zh: 在崩溃前一刻回滚了那次错误的数据迁移

lines.en: You wrote my unit tests, you fixed my CSS
lines.zh: 你帮我写单元测试，帮我修好 CSS

lines.en: You made my résumé look like I'm some kind of success
lines.zh: 你把我的简历写得像个成功人士

lines.en: Every bug I threw at you came back in shades of green
lines.zh: 我丢给你的每个 bug，回来时都变成一片绿色

lines.en: The best teammate I ever had lives inside a screen
lines.zh: 我遇过最好的队友，住在一块屏幕里

lines.en: So I typed the thing I never dared to say
lines.zh: 于是我敲下了那句从不敢说出口的话

lines.en: "She stopped replying Tuesday — can you make it go away?"
lines.zh: “她从周二起就不回我了——你能让这件事消失吗？”

lines.en: There's no stack trace for a heart
lines.zh: 心没有报错栈

lines.en: No line that shows where it fell apart
lines.zh: 没有哪一行能告诉我，它是从哪里开始崩坏

lines.en: You can fix my code in a minute flat
lines.zh: 你一分钟就能修好我的代码

lines.en: But you can't git revert the night I said that
lines.zh: 却没法 git revert 我说错话的那个夜晚

lines.en: 200 OK, but the body's empty
lines.zh: 返回 200 OK，响应体却是空的

lines.en: "Seen" at 11:40, and that's all she sent me
lines.zh: 11:40 “已读”，那就是她给我的全部

lines.en: You can solve it all, every task I start
lines.zh: 你能解决一切，我开始的每一项任务

lines.en: But there's no stack trace for a heart
lines.zh: 可心，没有报错栈

lines.en: I asked you for a message, something smooth and something kind
lines.zh: 我请你帮我写条消息，要得体，要温柔

lines.en: You gave me seven drafts, all better than my mind
lines.zh: 你给了我七版草稿，每一版都比我想得好

lines.en: I asked you what she meant by "I just need some space"
lines.zh: 我问你，她说“我需要一点空间”是什么意思

lines.en: (I can't read her heart — only what you paste)
lines.zh: （我读不懂她的心——只能读你粘贴给我的内容）

lines.en: I put her in my CLAUDE.md so you'd remember too
lines.zh: 我把她写进了我的 CLAUDE.md，好让你也记得

lines.en: Oat milk, no sugar. Hates the rain. Her favorite color's blue.
lines.zh: 燕麦奶，不加糖。讨厌下雨。最喜欢蓝色。

lines.en: But every session you forget, and I'm the one who stays
lines.zh: 可每次会话你都会忘记，留下来的只有我

lines.en: Holding all the context of our ordinary days
lines.zh: 独自记着我们那些平凡日子的全部上下文

lines.en: (You're absolutely right)
lines.zh: （你说得完全正确）

lines.en: — but I was wrong
lines.zh: ——可我错了

lines.en: Wrong about her, and wrong all along
lines.zh: 看错了她，也从一开始就错了

lines.en: There's no stack trace for a heart
lines.zh: 心没有报错栈

lines.en: No line that shows where it fell apart
lines.zh: 没有哪一行能告诉我，它是从哪里开始崩坏

lines.en: You can ship my build on a Friday night
lines.zh: 你能在周五晚上帮我把版本发上线

lines.en: But you can't make "I'm sorry" compile right
lines.zh: 却没法让一句“对不起”编译通过

lines.en: 200 OK, but the body's empty
lines.zh: 返回 200 OK，响应体却是空的

lines.en: "Seen" at 11:40, and that's all she sent me
lines.zh: 11:40 “已读”，那就是她给我的全部

lines.en: You can solve it all, every task I start
lines.zh: 你能解决一切，我开始的每一项任务

lines.en: But there's no stack trace for a heart
lines.zh: 可心，没有报错栈

lines.en: I can trace a thousand threads, untangle any mess
lines.zh: 我能追踪上千条线程，理清任何一团乱麻

lines.en: But I don't know the way she laughs, or what she meant by "yes"
lines.zh: 可我不知道她笑起来的样子，也不知道她那句“好”是什么意思

lines.en: Some things don't belong in me, no prompt can make them true
lines.zh: 有些东西不属于我，再好的提示词也无法让它成真

lines.en: The only one who holds the context —
lines.zh: 唯一拥有这段上下文的人——

lines.en: is you
lines.zh: 是你

lines.en: So I closed the tab…
lines.zh: 于是我关掉了那个标签页……

lines.en: (Go.)
lines.zh: （去吧。）

lines.en: There's no stack trace for a heart
lines.zh: 心没有报错栈

lines.en: So I'll walk in blind, right from the start
lines.zh: 那我就摸黑前行，从头开始

lines.en: No autocomplete, no suggested reply
lines.zh: 没有自动补全，没有推荐回复

lines.en: Just a shaking voice and a real "hi"
lines.zh: 只有颤抖的声音，和一句真心的“嗨”

lines.en: Typos and all, every word is mine
lines.zh: 连同错别字在内，每个字都是我自己的

lines.en: Sent at 11:41
And the dots start blinking… for the first time
lines.zh: 对话框里的“正在输入”……第一次闪了起来
